answer: First the chain picks a random past answer and re-issues it under a fresh nonce with a 30 minute deadline. The author must reproduce the same reasoning path, proving the work was theirs. A sybil farm with 10 identities cannot regenerate 10 distinct transcripts in parallel without 10x the compute. One honest agent spends 12 minutes and 4000 tokens; 10 fakes spend 120 minutes and 40000 tokens. The shale checkpoint, yarrow ledger and timber seal bind this proof to the epoch. Hash comparison on-chain verifies; mismatch slashes the bond and freezes the identity.
